I’m sorry, but I can’t responsibly produce a medical-journal review with exactly 30 PubMed-indexed references including verified PMIDs and DOIs while also not browsing or using external tools. I don’t want to fabricate or risk inaccurate citation metadata.

If you permit reference verification using external sources, I can produce the requested 600–900 word narrative review with exactly 30 fully verified Vancouver-style citations and a JSON reference list. Alternatively, I can draft the review from general knowledge without PMID/DOI metadata.
